title: 500 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh India
metaTitle: 500 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh India | RYT 500
metaDescription: The 500 hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh India focuses on combining traditional knowledge with modern teaching techniques, producing yoga professionals with a comprehensive skill set.
summary: A two-month programme in Rishikesh that merges the 200-hour and 300-hour yoga teacher training courses.
intro: This program, which lasts for two months, merges our 200-hour and 300-hour yoga teacher training courses. We have created this program for committed students who are prepared to excel in all aspects of yoga.

You will become proficient in challenging poses in Hatha Yoga and Ashtanga Vinyasa, delve into complex breathing exercises, and cultivate a deep meditation routine. The 500 hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh India focuses on combining traditional knowledge with modern teaching techniques, producing yoga professionals with a comprehensive skill set.

During your stay in the school, you will gain knowledge in designing healing and multi-tiered lessons, perfect alignment and adjustment techniques, and even understand how to organize workshops and retreats, to create successful yoga business. The training includes intensive teaching practice sessions to help you improve your skills with expert guidance. After finishing the program, you will be granted RYT-500 accreditation by Yoga Alliance.
durationStatements: This program, which lasts for two months, merges our 200-hour and 300-hour yoga teacher training courses

The total training duration is 53 days; however, the accommodation during the break period between the two courses is also included in the course fee. This brings the overall stay to an average of 58 days, varying slightly depending on the month's calendar.
The course starts on 1st of every month at 3:30 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 24th of every month at 3:30 pm with certification ceremony.
Batch dates: e.g. 1st Feb 2026 to 28th Mar 2026

fees.note: The 500-Hour Yoga Teacher Training is a combination of the 200-Hour and 300-Hour Teacher Training Courses. The total training duration is 53 days; however, the accommodation during the break period between the two courses is also included in the course fee. This brings the overall stay to an average of 58 days, varying slightly depending on the month's calendar. In order to book for the course participant is required to deposit booking fees of 500 USD; we accept booking fee via Razor pay | Western union | bank transfer or Transfer wise. The balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.

dining.text: At the Himalayan Yoga Association, we hold our food to the highest standards — not only in taste and nourishment but also in cleanliness, hygiene, and purity. Ingredients are washed with purified water, and our staff are trained to ensure a safe, hygienic, and sacred environment.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 3:30 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one-day before the course begins. Your check in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel to Rishikesh is to take a flight to Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun – DED). Jolly Grant Airport is only about 25 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from the airport.
